item.title: New ACG Guideline Addresses Key Diverticulitis Challenges
item.description: The new ACG guideline offers recommendations on antibiotics and diet for colonic diverticulitis, addressing major clinical questions.

item.title: Hong Kong Develops First Screening Tool for Social Frailty in Seniors
item.description: A new tool helps frontline workers detect social frailty in older adults, addressing loneliness and isolation.

item.title: Anesthesia Type May Not Affect Cancer Surgery Outcomes
item.description: Propofol and volatile anesthetics show similar survival outcomes in cancer surgery, with no significant differences.

item.title: Intensive Blood Pressure Control Reduces Recurrent Stroke Risk
item.description: Aggressive blood pressure lowering after intracerebral hemorrhage significantly cuts recurrent stroke risk, according to a meta-analysis.
